method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: compilation from legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 48940, Act No. 21 of 2023, retrieved 7 September 2026); no compilation or reprint number stated; latest amendment in the compilation table: No. 40 of 2024, in operation 30 October 2024; with the Workers Compensation and Injury Management Regulations 2024, compilation version 00-c0-00 current from 30 June 2026 (mrdoc 49606, retrieved 19 October 2026; last amendment SL 2026/35)

scope: ss 12, 13, 215 with regs 13-16, 18 (am I a worker, who is my employer); ss 6, 17, 19, 20 (liability); ss 25, 28, 29, 36, 47 with regs 19, 22 (claim in time, deemed acceptance at day 120, provisional payments at day 28, first payment within 14 days); ss 46, 48, 51, 55-57 with regs 23, 24 (income compensation at 100% for 26 weeks then 85%, capped, ending at the general maximum amount); ss 69, 75-78 (medical expenses: 60% of the general maximum amount, standard and special increases, special at 15% WPI); s 186, reg 90 (assessor, cost); ss 97-101, 18 of 45 Table items (lump sum, payable only on a registered settlement); ss 202, 204 (insurance; $10 000 per worker); ss 411, 415, 416, 421, 422, 423, 424, 434 with regs 120-122 (the 15% common-law threshold against the employer, the cost of an election under 25%, the cap under 25% from $530 724 indexed, third parties); s 538, s 566, regs 4, 134 (general maximum amount $252 724 indexed by the WA WPI)
